vc_checking.summary: The current hashes and 31-witness scope are valid, and 28 witnesses are semantically proofable, but the three nontrivial CircularAreaWrite return witnesses are not. In return_wit_1, return_wit_2, and return_wit_3, P owns the circular-area fields/store material at the current address circular_area and the input array at input_buffer, while Q requires store_circular_area at the independently quantified circular_area_pre and UCharArray.full at independently quantified input_buffer_pre. No hypothesis relates either current address to its @pre address. Syntactic non-assignment in C does not create a Rocq equality; the missing live bridge must be restored in C annotation/continuation facts before proving.

Three successful/full-state return obligations have a witness-local ownership gap: current pointer resources cannot be transported to unconstrained @pre pointer addresses without equality bridges. Those three are annotation-bug, so no downstream proof group plan is valid for this source_goal_version.

blockers.message: CircularAreaWrite_return_wit_1, _2, and _3 require heap resources at circular_area_pre/input_buffer_pre, but their preconditions own those resources only at circular_area/input_buffer and contain no equality bridges.

blockers.countermodel_outline: Choose circular_area_pre and input_buffer_pre nonzero and distinct from circular_area and input_buffer. Let the heap satisfy P using only the current addresses. For return_wit_1/_2, ErrorResult 0 is false, so only the success disjunct could hold, but its @pre-addressed heap is absent. For return_wit_3, choosing both @pre pointers nonzero eliminates the three error disjuncts, again leaving an unavailable @pre-addressed success heap.
blockers.required_annotation_rework: Preserve live equalities from current circular_area/input_buffer to their function-entry @pre values through each helper-call continuation so regenerated return VCs contain the two bridges. The public @pre contract may remain; do not edit generated witnesses by hand.
